About

    
pwnpal — a friend for your lonely pwnagotchi, and a full
    pwnagotchi in its own right. The ESP32 firmware is a complete Marauder build with the
    pwnpal command added.
    github.com/mrq1911/pwnpal

  


  

    Capture conversion runs entirely in your browser — pcaps/handshakes are never uploaded. The map
    loads tiles from OpenStreetMap, so only the map viewport (not your AP data) reaches the tile servers.
    
USB pull uses Web Serial (Chrome/Edge), reading /ext/apps_data/pwnpal/ via the Flipper
    CLI storage command — close qFlipper/lab.flipper.net first (one app owns the port). No USB? Copy
    the pwnpal folder off the SD with qFlipper and drop it above.
    
Crack: hashcat -m 22000 pwnpal.hc22000 <wordlist>. Wardrive: upload the CSV at
    wigle.net → Uploads.
